issues.title: Professional engine has no measured audible advantage over Standard
issues.root_cause: Engines share every decision and the limiter; only the sub/punch compression split differs, used only when the plan compresses.
issues.evidence: Synthetic baseline pairs *_pro vs Standard: identical on 2/3, <=0.1 dB on the third.
issues.repro: cd backend && python -m benchmark.regression --synthetic --baseline benchmark/baselines/synthetic.json ; compare rock_transient vs rock_transient_pro rows.
